common_error: In 27.53, what is the place value of 5?
why: The source decomposes 27.53 into 2 tens, 7 units, 5 tenths and 3 hundredths.
Dividing by 10 moves the decimal point one place left.
The source example multiplies 58×124=7192 and places three decimal digits.
The source converts 3.9 to 39/10 and obtains 39/100=0.39.
